summary: A softer-looking seat is an easy upgrade to sell. Deciding whether it improves the way you actually use a car takes more care. For the UK AION V, the useful starting distinction is unusually concrete: the published UK specification separates base leatherette upholstery from genuine leather with Premium Pack. That gives a buyer something to compare, but it does not establish that every comfort feature requires the package or that a similarly named car abroad carries the same equipment.
